pin_convention.summary: A pin records the commit at which a claim was actually read. It is never rewritten - not by a pin lift, not by a refresh pass. A later re-reading is appended to verifications, which carries strictly more than a replaced SHA would.

roles.observation: A historical record of where a claim was read. It carries no standing obligation; the immutable SHA keeps it checkable forever.
roles.binding: A present-tense claim about what upstream currently says. The pin still records where it was read, and the reference additionally carries a standing re-verification obligation.

lookup.summary: One synchronous tool call that answers now and keeps nothing.

deep_research.summary: A long-running autonomous investigation that produces a cited report.
deep_research.bounded_by: the job lifecycle, not the caller's turn

tier_separation_rationale.claim: A synchronous tool call and a long-running autonomous job are incompatible execution forms and cannot share one service grade.
grounds: A synchronous call must return inside the caller's turn; the Hand declares max_iterations 25 and a 120s heartbeat because its calls routinely outlive one turn.
A synchronous call has no identity to ask about afterwards; a job needs an addressable id for status, result, and cancellation.
A synchronous call keeps nothing; a deep run produces a report artifact that must live somewhere and be referenced.
depth and output_style are meaningless for a single fetch: there is no multi-pass budget to spend and no report to format.

depth.invention_policy: closed set; no step may be added, renamed, or reordered without changing the Hand first

output_style.invention_policy: closed set; no style may be added, renamed, or reordered without changing the Hand first

settings_not_surfaced.rationale: The Hand declares further settings. They stay Hand-side configuration and are deliberately not lifted into this contract, because E11 named depth and output_style only.

style_precedents: agentfarm.run starts and agentfarm.results reads back, both keyed on run_id

lifecycle_alignment.note: The proposed status values are the ones ResearchJobV1 already allows; this draft introduces no new lifecycle.

triggers: the internal context is absent for the subject
Rowboat answers but returns nothing for the subject
context_policy.rationale: Internal context makes a report better, not true. Losing it must degrade the run, not fail it — but a reader who cannot tell that internal context was missing would over-trust the report, so the omission is stated in the report itself.

evidence_policy.rationale: A report without citations is indistinguishable from the model answering from memory, which is the exact failure the existing execution target already refuses to pass off as research.

precedent.behaviour: returns ok=false with 'unverified research result: source evidence is missing' when no source URL is present

idea_side.rationale: The merged contract family already caps the idea-facing text at 4000 characters and keeps the report itself behind ResearchResultV1.artifact_refs. The idea side needs no schema change at all.

artifact_side.pin_note: The first pinned commit at which this file exists. It was absent at c5cba96 and a9a48af, so this reference could not be anchored before the n8n pin chain landed; it is anchored at its first observation, not refreshed from an earlier one.
artifact_side.re_run_semantics: a second run on the same subject inserts a new row; rows are never updated in place
fail_closed_storage_guards: citation_count >= 1, so an uncited report cannot be stored at all
a report written without internal context must carry a disclosure text
artifact_side.d2_neutral: The row carries both idea_id and bubble_id, so a single cluster report and a per-member report are both storable without a further migration. D2 stays open.

link_direction.consequence: public.ideas is untouched, so to_jsonb(NEW) in emit_ideas_sync_event keeps its present shape and the ideas sync workers need no change.

pointer.rationale: ideas.metadata is an existing JSONB column. Carrying a list of 38-character ids there costs the sync outbox almost nothing, unlike carrying a report-sized body, and it is what lets the Rowboat-rendered idea markdown name the report it summarises.

on_idea_delete.rationale: Matches swe_design_artifacts, which cascades its artifacts from the owning run, and bounds the dangling-reference risk that the linked-artifact shape otherwise carries.

sync_chain.grounds: trg_emit_ideas_sync is bound to public.ideas alone, so an insert into research_report_artifacts emits nothing. No trigger on the new table is created by the migration.
sync_chain.what_still_reaches_rowboat: the idea summary and the pointer, through the existing DB->FS markdown render

D1.question: Where does a Deep Research report physically live?
D1.decision_record_note: E14 is cited by the task brief as a user decision but is not present in docs/governance/architecture-decisions-2026-08-16-v1.md, whose E-series ends at E13. Recording it there is the orchestrator's to do; task-research-0003 holds no authority in docs/governance/ and did not write to it.

D2.question: Does a bubble subject produce one report over the cluster or one report per member idea?

D3.question: Does the report artifact join the ideas sync chain, or stay outside it?
D3.consequence_for_e12: Rowboat is the internal reference source for a later run. A report that never reaches Rowboat's knowledge base cannot answer 'what do we already know?' the next time. Under the recommended option the idea summary and the artifact pointer do reach it; the report body does not.
